purpose: Reassure enterprise buyers with security/scale claims

responsive.phone: Divider element has no fixed height (grows with content); stat panel sits flush to its container edges.
responsive.tablet: Divider becomes a fixed-height vertical rule (tablet:h-auto tablet:self-stretch tablet:w-px); stat panel insets from the container (tablet:top-0 tablet:bottom-5 tablet:left-5 tablet:right-5 tablet:rounded-card); heading steps to tablet:text-h3-t; stat rows switch to a row layout (tablet:flex-row) with a 40px gap (tablet:gap-10).
responsive.desktop: Outer padding widens (desktop:px-40); heading steps to desktop:text-h3 with desktop:text-body-l; the stat panel corner radius switches to the larger desktop:rounded-panel-lg token; divider min-height collapses to 0 (desktop:min-h-0, vs. tablet:min-h-[180px]).
